Market today:
Bearish mood. Fed hike expectations and rising Treasury yields are the main drivers, directly hurting growth/tech. China's economic slowdown adds to the pressure.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-60.26%) and SPAL (-33.64%) are critical due to deep losses and leveraged decay. QQQ (-0.77%), SMH (-14.91%), and QQQI (-3.92%) are flagged for trimming. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on Fed commentary and any further signs of economic weakness from China. Also, re-evaluate stops on your leveraged positions.

Bottom line:
The market is bracing for higher rates and a China slowdown; protect your capital, especially in leveraged positions.
plays: SOXL: Your -60.26% loss on this 3X leveraged ETF is severe. Consider cutting losses to preserve capital. The listed stop at 200 is not a protective stop at current prices.
SPAL: This leveraged ETF is also down significantly (-33.64%). Given the "SELL" status, consider exiting to limit further decay and loss.
SOXS: With Fed hike expectations rising and China slowing, consider a small, speculative long on SOXS (inverse chip ETF) as a short-term hedge. Entry 50.55-50.5, stop 50.07.
